identity.title: Restricted Live Canary
identity.objective: Implement after independent certification and explicit Phase A/B authority the smallest manual foreground one-strategy one-market LIMIT-only restricted-live canary with a single-use exact-head arm receipt, fixed hard capital and loss caps, durable pre-transmit create identity, one post_order transmit per attempt, authoritative reconciliation, persistent halt and restart-to-disabled behavior, dynamic geoblock checks, and read-only operator evidence, while requiring a separate exact-head human Gate-C activation decision before any capital is used.
identity.xl_authorization_basis: Karl authorized WP175 Phase A and Phase B implementation in chat on 2026-09-16 under the revised master package, then explicitly authorized Side10's bounded expansion from 29 to exactly 30 paths for the machine-spec-aware historical compatibility guard and final hardening. It does not authorize a 31st path, Gate-C live-capital activation, private-key use, real capital, a real economic CREATE, merge, or WP176.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert WP175. A3 restricted-live authority, Gate-C arm/create/reconciliation logic, manual operator command, canary receipt, cockpit projection, focused tests, and WP175 status evidence disappear. Merged WP174B Gate-B authentication, signing, cancellation, credential isolation, and Gate-C-required create lock remain intact. No live receipt, secret, venue response, or local canary store is committed or migrated.

api_matrix.reason: WP175 adds a private Gate-C create transport, manual arm/operator surface, durable restricted-live state and GET-only cockpit evidence while preserving Gate-B credential and cancel semantics.
